_about: 奇遇 templates. Ling writes the tale; the rules count turns and pay from the capped table on close.

about.zh: 一州的见闻或传说，取自《山海经》与地方故事。
about.en: A sight or legend of the province, from the Classic of Mountains and Seas and local lore.

about.zh: 聊斋式的夜谈：狐、鬼、书生，点到为止。
about.en: A night tale in the manner of Liaozhai — fox, ghost, scholar — told lightly.
